desc: Derive core reduction: valid alkanes correspond to connected core sets of original-degree>=4 vertices with core degree <=4, size 3F+2.
Implement concise iterative core DP (top-4 child aggregation, O(N), no recursion) and output code only.
Verify on samples and edge cases (N<5, no good vertices, single good vertex, high-degree good center, good vertices separated by bad vertices).
If samples fail, debug core DP; if approach is wrong, switch to exact rooted degree-count DP.
